unit: sibling count and repeated sibling gender, birth-year, parentage-selector and conditional relationship fields
value_labels: B3 counts siblings who survived to age six. B4 records sibling gender and birth year. B5 selects siblings with a different parent; B6 records the corresponding parentage relationship. B5 includes a none option.
value_label_status: official questionnaire loop alignment and conditional B5-to-B6 route reviewed; identifier-free catalog only
mapping_status: candidate metadata mapped to official 2014 Life History Codebook; not analysis-ready
caveat: B4_1 sibling names are excluded. B5 selectors align to siblings in B4, and B6 is asked only for selected siblings; do not treat selector slots as separate exposure indicators or blank as No. Sibling birth year and composition are family context, not measured respondent dose; no sibling records are published. 2014 special Life History survey; retrospective self-report. The official release note states that no weight is provided. Do not pool into regular-wave weighted pairwise analyses without a separately justified target population and linkage/design plan.
